info.title: API.SH: SeatGeek
info.description: The SeatGeek API from API.SH: public SeatGeek data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Events of a SeatGeek category page: popular events, a list of events, and events by sub-genre, each with date, venue and ticket price stats in USD.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/seatgeek-category

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Category as in seatgeek.com/<slug>-tickets: concert, sports, theater, comedy, nba, nfl, mlb, nhl, broadway and others.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A SeatGeek category page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One SeatGeek event: date and time, status, ticket price stats in USD (lowest, median, average, highest), listing and ticket counts, venue with address, coordinates and capacity, performers, on-sale and presale info, the seating chart's map thumbnail, other dates of the same performer, and the full event record in `raw`. Pass the event `url`, or `venue`, `performer` or `q` to get the next upcoming event there or by them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/seatgeek-event

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A SeatGeek event page (ends in the event id).

parameters.name: venue
parameters.description: Venue slug (as in seatgeek.com/venues/<slug>/tickets); returns its next event.

parameters.name: performer
parameters.description: Performer slug; returns their next event.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A performer name; returns their next event.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: Chicago Bulls at New York Knicks

get.description:
Upcoming events in a SeatGeek city, optionally narrowed to a category (concerts, sports, theater, comedy), a genre within it and a date window (today, tomorrow, this weekend, next weekend): the city with its coordinates and radius, `total_events` matching, and the next events, each with date, venue, performers and ticket price stats in USD. For a performer's or a venue's events use /seatgeek/v1/performer or /seatgeek/v1/venue.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/seatgeek-events

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City as in seatgeek.com/cities/<city>: nyc, la, sf, chicago, boston, vegas, washington, philadelphia, miami, seattle and others. Required unless `url` is given.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A SeatGeek city page, such as https://seatgeek.com/cities/nyc/concerts/this-weekend.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only events of this category.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: A genre within `category`, as a slug: rock, pop, country, hip-hop, nba, nfl and others. Needs `category`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Only events in this date window (the city's local time); `datetime_start` and `datetime_end` give the window.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An artist's or team's upcoming events on SeatGeek (up to 25, with `total_events`), each with date and time (local and UTC), venue with address and coordinates, performers, category and ticket price stats in USD (lowest, median, average, highest, lowest base price), listing and ticket counts, and the event's ids on other ticket sites. Also the performer's name, type, images, divisions and collections. Find a performer by `slug` (as in seatgeek.com/<slug>-tickets), its `url`, or a name with `q`. For teams, `type=home` or `type=away` lists only home or away games (`total_events` then counts those).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/seatgeek-performer

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Performer as in seatgeek.com/<slug>-tickets.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A SeatGeek performer page.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A performer name; the site's best match is used.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Teams only: home, away or all (default). Needs slug or url.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
